info.title: Snapshot x402 API
info.summary: Pay-per-request Snapshot governance data for agents, paid in USDC on Algorand via x402.
info.description:
Read-only REST API over Snapshot (https://snapshot.box) governance data: spaces, proposals, results, votes and voting power. No API key and no account: every paid route is priced per request and paid with the x402 protocol (v2).

## How to pay
1. Call a paid route without payment. You get HTTP 402 and a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header: base64 JSON with `x402Version: 2`, the `resource`, and `accepts[]` (scheme `exact`, network, asset, amount in atomic units, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, extra).
2. Sign a payment for one of the `accepts` entries with an x402 client (for example `@x402/fetch` with `@x402/avm`) and retry the same request with the base64 payload in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.
3. On success you get HTTP 200, the data, and a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header (base64 JSON settlement receipt with the transaction id).

Payments are USDC on Algorand (mainnet ASA 31566704, 6 decimals), settled by the GoPlausible facilitator (https://facilitator.goplausible.xyz), which pays the network fee. You only need USDC. Settlement happens after the handler succeeds: requests that end in 4xx/5xx are not settled, so they are not charged. The one exception is a 502 `facilitator_error` after the settlement was submitted: the facilitator may still confirm it. Each payment works once; sign a new one for every request. Every unpaid request gets the 402 first (x402 clients and the facilitator probe routes without paying). Input is validated after the payment is verified: a malformed request returns 400 and is not charged.

## Pricing (defaults)
| Route | Price (USDC) |
|---|---|
| GET /v1/spaces/{id} | 0.01 |
| GET /v1/spaces/{id}/proposals | 0.01 |
| GET /v1/proposals/{id} | 0.01 |
| GET /v1/proposals/{id}/votes | 0.01 |
| GET /v1/vp | 0.02 |

Free: GET /, GET /openapi.json, GET /llms.txt, GET /healthz.

Errors are JSON `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`. Lists return `hasMore` and `next` (relative URL of the next page, or null).

Timestamps are unix seconds (UTC). Scores and voting power are decimal token amounts, not atomic units.

get.summary: What this is and how to pay

200.description: Service description, routes, prices and payment details.

get.description: HTML for browsers and link previews by default; JSON when the request prefers application/json.

200.description: Plain text summary of the routes, prices and payment flow for LLM agents.

get.summary: Space profile, settings and activity stats
get.description:
One Snapshot space: identity, voting strategies (names and symbols), voting settings, admins, treasuries, delegation portal and activity counters.

Default price: 0.01 USDC per successful request (x402 exact scheme). Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not settled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot space id (ENS-style name, case-insensitive, max 64 chars), e.g. ens.eth, aavedao.eth.

200.description: Paid response. The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header carries the settlement receipt.

get.summary: Proposals of a space, newest first
get.description:
Proposals of one space ordered by creation time (newest first), with live or final scores. Body text is not included; use GET /v1/proposals/{id}?include=body.

Default price: 0.01 USDC per successful request (x402 exact scheme). Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not settled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot space id (ENS-style name, case-insensitive, max 64 chars), e.g. ens.eth, aavedao.eth.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by state. Omit for all states.

200.description: Paid response. The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header carries the settlement receipt.

get.description:
One proposal with per-choice results (score, share of total, score per strategy), quorum, strategies and state. Add include=body for the Markdown body.

Default price: 0.01 USDC per successful request (x402 exact scheme). Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not settled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot proposal id: 0x + 64 hex (current), or a legacy IPFS CID (Qm... or baf...).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Set to body to include the proposal body (Markdown).

200.description: Paid response. The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header carries the settlement receipt.

Cache-Control.description: private, max-age=3600 when closed and scores final; 30 when active; 60 otherwise

get.description:
Votes on one proposal, ordered by voting power (default) or time, with the proposal choices so choice indexes can be mapped to labels. Choice format depends on the proposal type: single-choice and basic use a 1-based index; approval, ranked-choice and copeland use an array of 1-based indexes; weighted and quadratic use an object of index to weight. For shutter-private proposals the choice is an encrypted hex string until the proposal closes.

Default price: 0.01 USDC per successful request (x402 exact scheme). Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not settled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Snapshot proposal id: 0x + 64 hex (current), or a legacy IPFS CID (Qm... or baf...).

200.description: Paid response. The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header carries the settlement receipt.

Cache-Control.description: private, max-age=3600 when proposal closed and scores final; 30 otherwise

get.description:
Voting power of one address, broken down by strategy. With proposal: computed at the proposal snapshot block using the proposal strategies (final once the block is past). With space only: computed at the latest block using the current space strategies. At least one of space or proposal is required; if both are given the proposal must belong to the space.

Default price: 0.02 USDC per successful request (x402 exact scheme). Failed requests (4xx/5xx) are not settled.

parameters.name: voter
parameters.description: EVM address (0x + 40 hex) or Starknet address (0x + 64 hex). Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: Space id. Required when proposal is omitted.

parameters.name: proposal
parameters.description: Proposal id. Required when space is omitted.

200.description: Paid response. The PAYMENT-RESPONSE header carries the settlement receipt.

Cache-Control.description: private, max-age=86400 when vpState is final; 60 otherwise

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 v2 payment: base64-encoded JSON PaymentPayload built from one entry of the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header returned by a 402. See https://x402.org.

BadGateway.description: Snapshot upstream failed (upstream_error), or the payment facilitator failed or timed out (facilitator_error). Not charged, except that a facilitator timeout during settlement can still be confirmed on chain.

BadRequest.description: Invalid input. Checked after the payment is verified; the payment is not settled, so it is not charged.

error.message: first must be an integer from 1 to 100

MethodNotAllowed.description: Only GET is allowed on paid routes (method_not_allowed). Not charged.

Misdirected.description: The request used a host other than the public URL of this deployment (misdirected_request); the message names the URL to use. Not charged.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required. Decode the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, pay one of accepts[], retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Also returned when a payment is rejected (error.code payment_rejected, for example duplicate_payment or insufficient funds; the reason is also in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header error field) or not settled (settlement_failed; the data is withheld).

error.message: This route costs 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402. Any x402 client (for example @x402/fetch with @x402/avm) pays it for you.

RateLimited.description: Too many failed paid attempts from this client in the last minute (rate_limited). Not charged.

Unavailable.description: Snapshot upstream is rate limiting (upstream_rate_limited) or the payment facilitator is unreachable (facilitator_unavailable). Not charged. Retry after the Retry-After seconds.

UpstreamTimeout.description: Snapshot upstream timed out (upstream_timeout). Not charged.

error.message: Snapshot hub did not answer in time

docs.description: Where to read how to pay (402 only).

choice.description: Number, array of numbers, object of index to weight, or encrypted hex string (shutter, before close).

choiceLabel.description: Label of the chosen option for single-choice and basic proposals; null otherwise.

total.description: Number of votes on the proposal.
